**Bogsy modifiers** for Wren (#Game Night)  
Copy and paste one line at a time (Discord runs one command per message):  
`/modifier name:bonus_cm value:16`  
`/modifier name:bonus_cr value:0`  
`/modifier name:bonus_fear value:3`  
`/modifier name:bonus_stealth value:2`  
`/modifier name:bonus_escape value:1`  
`/modifier name:bonus_would_hurt value:0`  

**Set up once** (replace `<your dice>` with your combat dice, e.g. `7d20`):  
`/quickroll name:wren dicestring:<your dice> + my_cm + bonus_cm`  
`/quickroll name:challenge dicestring:1d20 + cr_level + my_cr_bonus + bonus_cr`  
**Rolling:** `/roll command:wren` for combat; for one CR type, add its modifiers, e.g. `/roll command:challenge+my_fear+bonus_fear`  
**Your own bonuses:** keep them in your own modifiers (`my_cm`, `my_fear`…); these never overwrite them
